definition: Activities that determine where data and digital services may be hosted and under what jurisdictional, ownership, control or assurance conditions. Includes government hosting policy, workload placement based on classification, approved hosting models, data residency and localisation, sovereign hosting, provider accreditation, jurisdiction and lawful-access risk, cross-border hosting, encryption-key custody, administrative access, portability and exit requirements. Excludes datacenter construction without a hosting-policy dimension, cloud migration without residency, jurisdiction or control requirements, general national-sovereignty language, cross-border connectivity, and physical records storage.
